body_markdown:
Learn how tactical, transportable and re-deployable SATCOM ground stations can help address the vulnerabilities of fixed infrastructure in contested environments. By creating an independent Point of Presence (POP), Gilat DataPath delivers solutions that support rapid deployment, greater redundancy and resilient communications for defense operations.


Read the White Paper here:[Tactical Transportable and Re-Deployable SATCOM Ground Stations](https://www.gilat.com/wp-content/uploads/Gilat-White-Paper-Tactical-Transportable-and-Re-Deployable-SATCOM-Ground-Stations-1.pdf)
